```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("/Users/caitlinwaterworth/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofBath/YM_combined_analysis/EU_combined_analysis/scripts")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)
library(Hmisc)

load("gba_functions.rda")
```

```{r load}
## Consensus half-life fold change -- SE < 0.75, c1 fitting
## gene_id, WT_small_hl, WT_large_hl, WT_hl_fc
df_consensus <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Vijjamarri et al. 2023 -- Dcp2 and Xrn1 deletion steady-state RNA-seq
## gene_id, log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT, padj_dcp2D, log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT, padj_xrn1D,
## TE_vijjamarri_WT
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants in YPD, not G1-arrested AID depletion
## steady-state accumulation confounded by transcriptional compensation
df_vijjamarri <- read_tsv("../tables/df_vijjamarri_gba.txt",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

## Chappleboim et al. 2022 -- Not1 and Xrn1 AID depletion time course
## gene_id, log2FC_not1_60min, log2FC_xrn1_60min,
## not1_sensitive (>0.75), xrn1_sensitive (>1.5)
## CAVEAT: AID depletion in exponentially growing cells, not G1-arrested
## 60 min time point used to limit transcriptional compensation
df_chappleboim <- read_tsv("../tables/df_chappleboim_gba.txt",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Consensus genes:", nrow(df_consensus), "\n")
cat("Vijjamarri genes:", nrow(df_vijjamarri), "\n")
cat("Chappleboim genes:", nrow(df_chappleboim), "\n")
```

```{r join}
## Join all datasets by gene_id
df_gba <- df_consensus %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_vijjamarri,  by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_chappleboim, by = "gene_id")

cat("Genes after join:", nrow(df_gba), "\n")
cat("Genes with Vijjamarri data:",
    sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT)), "\n")
cat("Genes with Chappleboim data:",
    sum(!is.na(df_gba$log2FC_not1_60min)), "\n")

## Check actual data range for ylim setting
cat("WT_hl_fc range (1st-99th percentile):\n")
print(quantile(df_gba$WT_hl_fc, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r s1_dcp2_correlation}
## Section 1 -- Half-life fold change vs Dcp2 deletion signature
## Vijjamarri et al. -- log2FC in dcp2D vs WT
## Positive dcp2D FC = Dcp2-dependent decay target
## Negative R suggests Dcp2 targets do NOT gain more stability in large cells
## CAVEAT: deletion mutant in YPD -- chronic transcriptional compensation
##         likely explains the unexpected negative correlation

p1a <- scatter_binned(df_gba,
                      x_col     = "log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT",
                      y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                      x_lab     = "log2 FC after Dcp2 deletion (Vijjamarri)",
                      y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                      title     = "Half-life FC vs Dcp2 deletion signature",
                      point_col = col_small,
                      ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                      xlim      = c(-4, 4)) +
  labs(tag = "A")

p1a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_dcp2_correlation.png",
       plot = p1a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s2_xrn1_vijjamarri_correlation}
## Section 2 -- Half-life fold change vs Xrn1 deletion signature (Vijjamarri)
## Negative R -- same caveat as Dcp2; steady-state deletion confounded by
## widespread transcriptional buffering (Sun et al. 2013 showed ~1.6x increase
## in synthesis rates in xrn1D, masking true decay effects)

p2a <- scatter_binned(df_gba,
                      x_col     = "log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT",
                      y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                      x_lab     = "log2 FC after Xrn1 deletion (Vijjamarri)",
                      y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                      title     = "Half-life FC vs Xrn1 deletion signature",
                      point_col = col_large,
                      ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                      xlim      = c(-5, 2)) +
  labs(tag = "B")

p2a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_vijjamarri_correlation.png",
       plot = p2a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s3_not1_correlation}
## Section 3 -- Half-life fold change vs Not1 depletion signature (Chappleboim)
## R ~ 0 -- CCR4-NOT deadenylation does not drive size-dependent stability

p3a <- scatter_binned(df_gba,
                      x_col     = "log2FC_not1_60min",
                      y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                      x_lab     = "log2 FC after Not1 depletion, 60 min (Chappleboim)",
                      y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                      title     = "Half-life FC vs Not1 depletion signature",
                      point_col = col_small,
                      ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                      xlim      = c(-1, 2)) +
  labs(tag = "C")

p3a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_not1_correlation.png",
       plot = p3a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s4_xrn1_chappleboim_correlation}
## Section 4 -- Half-life fold change vs Xrn1 depletion signature (Chappleboim)
## Weakly positive R -- Xrn1-sensitive transcripts show slightly larger
## stability increases in large cells. Most biologically consistent result.
## AID depletion at 60 min limits transcriptional compensation artefacts.

p4a <- scatter_binned(df_gba,
                      x_col     = "log2FC_xrn1_60min",
                      y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
                      x_lab     = "log2 FC after Xrn1 depletion, 60 min (Chappleboim)",
                      y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                      title     = "Half-life FC vs Xrn1 depletion signature",
                      point_col = col_large,
                      ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                      xlim      = c(-0.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "D")

p4a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_chappleboim_correlation.png",
       plot = p4a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s5_gene_set_not1}
## Section 5 -- Gene set comparison: Not1-sensitive vs other
## p = 0.308 -- Not1-sensitive genes do not show significantly different
## half-life fold changes. Consistent with near-zero continuous correlation.

p5a <- violin_comparison(df_gba,
                         flag_col         = "not1_sensitive",
                         value_col        = "WT_hl_fc",
                         x_lab            = "",
                         y_lab            = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                         title            = "Not1-sensitive vs other genes",
                         sensitive_label  = "Not1-sensitive\n(n=622)",
                         other_label      = "Other",
                         ylim             = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "E")

p5a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_not1_geneset.png",
       plot = p5a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s6_gene_set_xrn1}
## Section 6 -- Gene set comparison: Xrn1-sensitive vs other
## p < 0.001 -- Xrn1-sensitive genes show significantly higher fold changes
## median 0.876 vs 0.799. Consistent with positive continuous correlation.

p6a <- violin_comparison(df_gba,
                         flag_col         = "xrn1_sensitive",
                         value_col        = "WT_hl_fc",
                         x_lab            = "",
                         y_lab            = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
                         title            = "Xrn1-sensitive vs other genes",
                         sensitive_label  = "Xrn1-sensitive\n(n=303)",
                         other_label      = "Other",
                         ylim             = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "F")

p6a
ggsave("../figures/GBA_xrn1_geneset.png",
       plot = p6a, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r s7_summary_panel}
## Section 7 -- Summary panel: all six plots together

panel <- (p1a | p2a | p3a) /
         (p4a | p5a | p6a) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

panel
ggsave("../figures/GBA_summary_panel.png",
       plot   = panel,
       width  = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi    = 150)

cat("Saved GBA_summary_panel.png\n")
```

```{r s8_overlap}
## Section 8 -- Overlap between sensitive gene sets

n_not1      <- sum(df_gba$not1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_xrn1      <- sum(df_gba$xrn1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_both      <- sum(df_gba$not1_sensitive & df_gba$xrn1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE)
n_not1_only <- n_not1 - n_both
n_xrn1_only <- n_xrn1 - n_both

cat("Not1-sensitive only:", n_not1_only, "\n")
cat("Xrn1-sensitive only:", n_xrn1_only, "\n")
cat("Both Not1 and Xrn1 sensitive:", n_both, "\n")
cat("Neither:", nrow(df_gba) - n_not1 - n_xrn1 + n_both, "\n")

df_gba <- df_gba %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sensitivity_group = case_when(
    not1_sensitive & xrn1_sensitive ~ "Both",
    not1_sensitive                  ~ "Not1 only",
    xrn1_sensitive                  ~ "Xrn1 only",
    TRUE                            ~ "Neither"))

p8 <- ggplot(df_gba %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(WT_hl_fc)),
             aes(x = sensitivity_group, y = WT_hl_fc,
                 fill = sensitivity_group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.4, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Both"      = col_A,
    "Not1 only" = col_small,
    "Xrn1 only" = col_large,
    "Neither"   = "grey70")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(x     = "",
       y     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
       title = "Half-life fold change by decay pathway sensitivity",
       tag   = "G") +
  cell_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p8
ggsave("../figures/GBA_sensitivity_groups.png",
       plot = p8, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```
